headerDisplay: Monitor Atlas Home Security (RISCO Cloud) detectors and, optionally, arm and disarm from Apple Home. Credentials remain in your Homebridge configuration.

username.title: Atlas / RISCO username
username.description: The email address you use to sign in to the Atlas app.

pin.title: Panel user code (PIN)
pin.description: Required by RISCO Cloud to open a panel session. A rejected code pauses the plugin until restart to avoid a keypad lockout.

siteId.title: Site ID (optional)
siteId.description: Only needed when the account has more than one site. Run npm run diagnose to list site IDs.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Polling only: seconds between polls. Push: interval used while the push connection is unavailable.

debug.title: Debug diagnostics
debug.description: Write a sanitized diagnostic report (states, counts and vendor field names; no zone names or credentials) to the Homebridge log at most once every five minutes. Search the log for “Diagnostic report”.

enableControl.title: Enable arming and disarming
enableControl.description: Off by default. When off, the security system is read-only in Apple Home.

zones.title: Zone overrides
zones.description: Managed by the settings page: every discovered zone with its sensor type, or hidden. Zones not listed use name-based defaults.
